comments.author: Kryptic-S01
comments.body_html:
I finished my 12 years of service in the Royal Engineers in the British army in 2018. My combined primary weapon system I used was the SA80/L85A2 (ocassionally the A1 as well), all used and tested thoroughly for years but ageing like sour milk. I hated using them on stints and at the ranges. However, I recently visited my old barracks where I trained at and linked up with some of the lads I trained with from my unit, and after some back and forth with the brass there we were allowed to test fire the KS-1 and boy oh boy was it a joy to play with. A much easier and manageable firing system to operate plus it weighs considerably less than the SA80’s and L85’s. The issues I could see with it is the quality of the magazines/the magwell, feed ramp overhangs and machining blemishes which apparently required the weapon to be returned to the factory for repairs, and lastly the limitation of aftermarket upgrades (which isn’t too much of an issue if left as standard as it’s already good).

Anyway enough of my rambling, thanks for keeping this updated! :)

comments.body_html: The SOLGW MK1 features a 5/8×24 TPI muzzle thread pitch. The SOLGW MK1 CAR uses a 5/8×24 threads per inch (TPI) muzzle thread, rather than the more common 1/2×28 TPI found on standard 5.56 barrels. however currently we have the huxwrx 5.56 muzzle device attaching to it which is wrong, it will have the proper huxwrx 5/28 and hux black magic suppressor in the next update. so yes it is supposed to fit the 7.62x51 suppressors
